ca2fa419da748b.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Climate Change Performance Index (CCPI) 2026?
o: It was released at COP30 in Belem, Brazil.
India rose 13 places in the index.
It is published by Germanwatch, NewClimate Institute and Climate Action Network.
ca2fa419da748b.x: India fell, not rose, 13 places to 23rd in CCPI 2026, which was released at COP30 in Belem, Brazil.

cae42d2b349bac.s: Which of the following is one of the four categories of the Climate Change Performance Index (CCPI)?
cae42d2b349bac.x: The four CCPI categories are GHG Emissions, Renewable Energy, Energy Use and Climate Policy.

cab75343e55b2e.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about heat impacts in India as per the Lancet Countdown 2025?

The area affected by extreme drought rose by 138%.
India recorded 419 extra heatwave hours per person in 2024.
India saw 50% more heatwave days in 2024.
cab75343e55b2e.x: India recorded 366 extra heatwave hours per person; 419 was the lost labour hours per person.

ca96b4e7a72eab.s: As per NITI Aayog's 2025 report, what was the services sector's share of India's employment in 2023–24?

ca8e8f967d2dc2.s: According to the State of Global Air (SoGA) 2025 report, about how many air-pollution deaths did India record in 2023?

cafb6a5b0d3cb0.x: Nigeria doubled its 2030 oil target; Brazil raised its target by 47%.
